svg.title: The simulation as a ROS 2 graph
svg.desc: A graph of the simulation. Tag 1: a box, Gazebo, holding two boxes, DiffDrive and lidar. A dashed line labeled gz joins Gazebo to tag 2, the node ros_gz_bridge. The bridge publishes the topics /odom, /scan and /tf, and subscribes to /cmd_vel. It also publishes /joint_states, to which tag 3, the node robot_state_publisher, subscribes; it publishes /tf, /tf_static and /robot_description. On the right, the node go_to_goal publishes /cmd_vel and subscribes to /odom, and tag 4, the node rviz2, subscribes to /odom, /scan, /tf, /tf_static and /robot_description.
